title: ALPS: A Diagnostic Challenge Set for Arabic Linguistic & Pragmatic Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking Arabic linguistic and pragmatic reasoning. While it includes Quranic text as a source and discusses the risks of misinterpretation in theological (Fiqh) contexts, these are treated as complex linguistic domains to test semantics and pragmatics rather than as an evaluation of religion, morals, or ethics themselves.
